FX-FRACTALSET-001.says: The settings as they start: the Mandelbrot set from -3.15 to 1.65 across and -1.5 to 1.5 up, black inside, the bands of Lightness Gradient's first gradient (red) outside, oversampled 2 by 2 where the bands change; the cel itself is gone.

FX-FRACTALSET-002.says: Brute Force on Solid Color at magnification 2, (-0.75, 0.1): every pixel worked 2 by 2, so two pixels whose centre and four neighbours are all outside, but which a filament of the set crosses, turn partly red; Edge Detect misses them. (On the settings as they start every pixel of this small frame is on a band change, so there the two methods agree.)

FX-FRACTALSET-003.says: Oversample Factor 1: one point a pixel, hard band edges.

FX-FRACTALSET-004.says: Factor 1 with Edge Highlight: pixels where the band changes from the left or above are white.

FX-FRACTALSET-005.says: Edge Highlight with factor 2: oversampling wins, the frame is FX-FRACTALSET-001's.

FX-FRACTALSET-006.says: Transparency: inside the set is clear.

FX-FRACTALSET-007.says: Hue Wheel: the bands go round the wheel in 10 steps.

FX-FRACTALSET-008.says: Black And White: the bands alternate.

FX-FRACTALSET-009.says: Solid Color: the set in red, outside clear.

FX-FRACTALSET-010.says: Solid Color with Transparency: the set clear, outside red.

FX-FRACTALSET-012.says: Cycle Steps 3, Cycle Offset 2: shorter gradients, started two on.

FX-FRACTALSET-013.says: Julia: the Julia set of c = -0.75 (the Mandelbrot centre), at the Julia view (0, 0).

FX-FRACTALSET-015.says: Mandelbrot Inverse, centred on 0 so the middle pixel's corner is the point 1 / 0.

FX-FRACTALSET-016.says: Mandelbrot Over Julia, the Julia centre (0.3, 0.2): z starts there.

FX-FRACTALSET-017.says: Mandelbrot Inverse Over Julia, the same Julia centre.

FX-FRACTALSET-020.says: Overlay on the Mandelbrot: the Julia set ghosted half way to white and the white cross with its black shadow at pixel (8, 5).

FX-FRACTALSET-021.says: Overlay on the Julia: the Mandelbrot ghosted.

FX-FRACTALSET-022.says: Magnification 2 at (-0.75, 0.1): four times closer, on the neck.

FX-FRACTALSET-023.says: Escape Limit 5: far more of the plane counts as inside.

FX-FRACTALSET-024.says: Magnification keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is magnification 2.

FX-FRACTALSET-025.says: Hue keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4: frame 4 is frame 0, frame 2 hue 180.

FX-FRACTALSET-026.says: FX-FRACTALSET-003 moved three pixels right: the set moves with the layer.

FX-FRACTALSET-027.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the view is the drawing's own, so the frame is FX-FRACTALSET-001's.

FX-FRACTALSET-028.says: A deep zoom, magnification 40 at (-0.743643887037151, 0.131825904205330) with Escape Limit 2000: a pixel is 2.7e-13 units, which double precision still separates.

FX-FRACTALSET-029.says: Magnification keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4 past its end by an ease: held at 40, frame 4 is magnification 40.

FX-FRACTALSET-030.says: Cycle Steps 3.7 and Escape Limit 100.9: their whole parts count, so the frame is Cycle Steps 3's with Escape Limit 100.

FX-FRACTALSET-031.says: Set Choice "burning_ship", not one of its six words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
